establishment.name: BUSN' HALAL FROM THE STREETS OF NYC

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink by the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLACED THE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front service area being used to store a sanitizer bucket.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EMPLOYEE REMOVED BUCKET.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the cook line was blocked by 2 dr prep top, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED THE PREP TOP.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed employee washing food containers and not using sanitizer before putting them away to dry.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS EXPLAINED HOW TO PROPERLY WASH AND SANITIZE EQUIPMENT AND DISHES. EMPLOYEE SANITIZED FOOD CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: observed chicken cooked 3 hours ago at 72-88F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER COOLING METHODS. PIC DISCARDED CHICKEN.
